notes.title: Meet Gecata 5.9!
notes.content:
[list][*] The program now speaks Spanish. ¡Hola!
[*] You called for help and we heard you! We've returned the button "Show in Folder" to the main window.
[*] Meet the all new preferences! Now they are part of the main window, and all tabs are arranged horizontally.
[*] You don't need to apply changes in preferences anymore, the program will do it automatically.
[*] Setting the overlays' position is more convenient now. Go ahead and try!
[*] We've fixed video file size display on the overlay.
[*] Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Coming up! Gecata 5.9 release
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, gamers! We have some great news for you![/h3]

[b]Gecata 5.9[/b] will be released soon! We’ve added Spanish to our interface languages, rearranged the preferences so they’re more logical and intuitive, improved the functionality, and made setting up the overlay’s position more straightforward. And yes, thanks a lot for your feedback! This release includes some tweaks in program features and interface that wouldn’t have been there without your requests!

Stay tuned, the new Gecata is almost here!

Yours always,

[b]Gecata Team.[/b]

notes.title: Introducing Gecata 5.8!
notes.content:
Meet the all new Gecata! 
[list][*] Enjoy the brand new modern design.
[*] The program learned four more languages: Chinese, German, French and Brazilian Portuguese!
[*]To save you time, we’ve added a video manager. Edit and convert recorded videos without leaving Gecata!
[*] What’s more, the program now allows you to share your videos on YouTube!
[*] Minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Coming up! Gecata 5.8 release
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, gamers! We’re happy to bring you great news today![/h3]

The brand-new [b]Gecata 5.8[/b] is on its way to your wish-list, promising some new great opportunities to make game recording easier and more fun. We’ve added [b]new language options[/b] to the interface, integrated a [b]video manager[/b] into the program so that you can edit and convert your footage on the go, and made [b]sharing on YouTube[/b] possible directly from the program. What’s more, it’s all packed into a [b]completely new design[/b] that we hope you’ll like!

Can’t wait to test the new build? Don’t worry, it won’t be long!

Yours always,

[b]Gecata Team.[/b]

notes.title: Introducing Gecata 5.7!
notes.content:
The brand-new Gecata by Movavi 5.7 is out! Here are some of the key improvements in the latest update:

[list]
[*] Those unexpected quits that were happening in some games are now gone!
[*] We’ve tested Gecata with 25 more games, including Apex Legends, Borderlands 3, Fortnite, and PUBG, to make sure you get the smoothest recording experience
[*] You can now record the cursor in both game and desktop recording modes
[*] Don’t miss any updates. Just launch the program and we’ll keep you informed! 
[*] Other minor bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Meet Gecata 5.6!
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that [b]Gecata 5.6 by Movavi[/b] is now available! The new update includes some important fixes:
[list]
[*]no more accidental crashes at the end of the recording
[*]no more crashes when you pause the recording with Intel acceleration
[*]if you have other Movavi programs, they will work correctly  when Gecata is launched at the same time[/list]
